data.gender_notes: Faaiq is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Faaiq is a name of Arabic origin which means 'corrector' or 'victor'. It is derived from the Arabic root 'afa' meaning 'to correct' or 'to improve'. The name evokes a sense of righteousness and victory, as if the person named Faaiq is someone who consistently strives to better themselves and achieve success. The name Faaiq carries the meaning “Corrector, Victor, Successful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Faaiq usually hope their child will grow to embody corrector, victor, successful and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Faaiq belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Corrector, Victor, Successful.”
